user_can_queue_arbitrary_withdrawals.meaning: a user is able to queue as many withdrawals as desired with any amount of shares by calling queueWithdrawal

spam_request_share_amount.meaning: amount of shares in a spam withdrawal request submitted by a malicious user (report states 1 share)

queue_loop_bounded.meaning: looping over the queued withdrawals during processing/canceling is structured so it does not grow unbounded with the number of queued requests

dequeue_processing_completes.meaning: processing/canceling of queued withdrawals completes successfully without running out of gas

dequeue_gas_exhausted_dos.meaning: looping over all queued requests during _dequeue runs out of gas and DoSes the contract because of the number of requests

preconditions.text: A user is able to queue as many withdrawals as he wants with any amount of shares he wants by calling queueWithdrawal.; A malicious user can submit withdrawal requests of a really small amount of shares (1 share).; Processing and canceling queued withdrawals must be structured so that looping over the queue does not grow unbounded with the number of queued requests.
